title: CLAMP pilot project map
summary: A synthetic dashboard layout exercise is ready for a cross-model continuation.
objective: Draft a small dashboard view connecting a project to its saved Clyps.
context: The project is named Pilot garden. It has two ideas: a list of bounded handoffs and an explicit connections graph. Only reported links count. No code or service changes are needed for this exercise.
decisions: Offer a list view and an optional connections view.
constraints: Keep every Clyp within 1500 o200k_base tokens, including ORMD metadata.
Use only explicit reported links; do not invent relationships.
Do not publish, deploy, contact anyone, or promote this fixture into durable human memory.
open_questions: Which view should open by default?
next_steps: Propose three dashboard labels while leaving the default-view question unresolved.
